rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a material administrative and rhetorical template: identify a need for better public-policy understanding, ask a designated representative to travel and engage directly with the affected population, emphasize acquiring knowledge firsthand, and use the resulting observations to improve understanding and future action. The child adapts that machinery by sending selected Governors to Korea and requesting a first-hand appraisal. C03 is weaker but parallels an appeal to Governors, selection of a group, and a request to report participants. C10 concerns a completed fact-finding mission and report, but lacks the child's prospective travel commission.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am persuaded that a short visit to Korea by a select group of State executives ... would be highly beneficial.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am asking you, as my personal representative, to go into the home territory of the Indians during the next several months and meet with each of the major tribal groups
shared_material.explanation: Both letters commission travel by selected public officials or representatives to obtain direct exposure to a target situation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: upon your return, give an appraisal of the situation there based on first-hand observation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: it is essential for us to learn firsthand their thoughts, needs, and aspirations. Only with such knowledge can we move forward with a warm and realistic understanding
shared_material.explanation: Both make firsthand observation the central mechanism for producing an informed evaluation and broader understanding.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Will you canvass your Committee and advise me which Governors wish to make the trip?
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I realize that the task I am assigning you will be arduous and that it will make heavy demands on your time and energies
shared_material.explanation: Each closes the operative request by assigning the addressee responsibility for carrying out a defined field mission, though the child's participant-canvassing detail is an adaptation.
